outcome: Loading was confirmed to finish: in the verifier environment without the observer, LoadGameTask completes about 279 s after it starts and the global thread pool then goes idle. The earlier failures came from the startup observer, which applied its 20 s readiness deadline while the game kept its view hidden during loading and then exited underneath the loading task; it now applies the loading deadline as soon as background work is seen. #226 then verified with HISTORY_VERIFY_TIMEOUT=900 (smoke 699.7 s); #227-#236 verified with 1200 s.
reason: The surviving #226 GameScene::startGame runs LoadGameTask, which calls Map::ensureTile through BlockingQueuedConnection for every cell of the map plus a 10-tile border and shows the view only afterwards. The genuine CoordsHasher (surviving #180 coords.cpp, still identical at #366) returns (a^b)^(b^c)^(a^c), which is always 0, so every Coords-keyed unordered_map degenerates to one bucket and loading is quadratic. With the restored 200x200 maps/map.tmx (an unverified donor conversion of a later authored map) the load did not settle within the verification window.
